tools.name: cross_reference_oem_sku

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_industrial_parts · Private data: search_industrial_parts, submit_structured_rfq · Public sink: submit_structured_rfq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_industrial_parts · Private data: search_industrial_parts, submit_structured_rfq · Public sink: submit_structured_rfq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
